Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round seven

The shell is the complex

Each half of the oyster is a protein from PDB 5T35, and the pearl is the SELFTAC. BRD4, the target, is the lid; VHL, the ligase, is the cup. Their outlines are traced from the structure and smoothed into blobs, and where they meet the pearl they curve round it, so the two proteins cup the degrader between them, as they do in the real ternary complex. The surface contours inside each protein double as an oyster’s growth lines. One line weight throughout; the pearl in the logo’s pearl colour, the clasp in gold. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.

01

Line

BRD4 as the lid and VHL as the cup, each its traced surface from 5T35 smoothed into one line, with its first surface contour inside as a growth line. Between them, the pearl: the SELFTAC as two halves, clasped by a gold seam.

The brief in one line weight: an open oyster with its pearl, drawn from the real complex.
